Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:110262
Court No. - 65
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 28645 of 2024

Applicant :- Sumit Kumar @ Ankit Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Ankur Chaurasia,Diwan Saifullah Khan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Diwan Saifullah Khan, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Sunil Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3. Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No. 62 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Sahawar, District Kasganj, during the pendency of trial.
4.
As per prosecution story, marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the deceased person as per Hindu rites on 21.10.2023.
The applicant and other family members are stated to have subjected her to cruelty for demand of dowry and thereby led her to death on 10.03.2024 at ab out 2 p.m.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.

He has nothing to do with the said offence as alleged in Sumit Kumar @ Ankit Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199526094/
1 the FIR.

entities.text: Sumit Kumar @ Ankit Kumar vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is a clear cut case of false implication.
It was an inter-caste love marriage.
6. Learned counsel has further stated that there is no averement as to what was demanded as dowry in the FIR but subsequently, in the statements of the witnesses, allegation of demand of Rs.50,000/-
has been made.
It is next stated that the family status of both the parties are below the poverty line and there is no possibility of exchange of any pleasantries or dowry whatsoever.
The FIR is delayed by three days and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.

7. It is further stated that the inquest proceedings of the deceased person were conducted the same day and her post mortem could be conducted on 12.03.2024 only that too after her parents reached there and the informant and other family members were present at the time of cremation of the deceased person and the FIR has been instituted at 6:52 p.m. which is already delayed by more than one day from the date of her cremation.
The cause of death has been found to be asphyxia as a result of ante mortem hanging.
8. There is no criminal history of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 23.03.2024 and he is ready to cooperate with trial.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

9. Per contra, learned AGA has vehemently opposed the bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant and also the fact that the applicant has no criminal history.

10. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the delay in institution of the FIR, I find it a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
The bail application is allowed.

11. Let the applicant- Sumit Kumar @ Ankit Kumar, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i) The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii) The applicantshall not pressurise/intimidate with the prosecution witnesses.
iii) The applicantshall appear before the trial court on the date fixed.
12. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

13. It is made clear that observations made in granting bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
